title: Plan
loadError: The plan could not be loaded.
offlineUnknownTitle: The plan isn’t on this phone yet
offlineUnknownText: Feeder loads it the first time this phone is online. It will appear here as soon as the connection is back.
empty: Nothing is planned yet. Add Meal Slots in Settings, and some Recipes.
swapNone: No other Recipe fits this Meal Slot.
cookedQuestion: How many portions are left over?
cookedError: That could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
fromLeftoverNote: Served from a Leftover. Nothing is taken from Stock.
regenerateNone: No Planned Meals will change. Empty Meal Slots may be filled.
regenerateNote: Pinned and Cooked ones stay. You can undo it straight after.
slotRulesHelp: Set a Slot Rule to plan a Recipe or a Tag into a Meal Slot, for example Friday Dinner = pizza.
noTags: Add Tags to your Recipes to use them here.
varietyRulesHelp: Limit how often a Tag appears, for example fish at most twice a week.
ruleSaveError: The rule could not be saved.
errorSlotTagRequired: Choose the Tag this Meal Slot always gets.
errorVarietyTagRequired: Choose a Tag for the rule.
errorNothingLimited: Choose a weekly limit or not on consecutive days.
errorSlotRecipeRequired: Choose the Recipe this Meal Slot always gets.
couldntAskAdmin: Ask an Admin to change this.

couldntCauseText.no_recipes: There are no Recipes to choose from.
couldntCauseText.no_course_recipes: Some Courses have no Recipes marked for them.
couldntCauseText.slot_rule: Nothing that matches its Slot Rule is available.
couldntCauseText.excluded: Every Recipe is excluded for someone who eats it.
couldntCauseText.advance_step: Every Recipe needs an Advance Step that is already too late.
couldntCauseText.too_early: Every Recipe would start outside your cooking times.

couldntHint.nobody_attending: Pick the Members who eat at each Meal Slot, and the planner will fill it.
couldntHint.no_recipes: The planner picks from your Recipes. Add a few, or import a Recipe File.
couldntHint.no_course_recipes: The planner fills each Course from the Recipes marked with it. Mark some Recipes with the Course, or choose a Recipe yourself.
couldntHint.slot_rule: A Slot Rule asks for a Recipe or Tag that cannot be used here. Loosen the rule, or choose a Recipe yourself.
couldntHint.excluded: Someone who eats there cannot have any of your Recipes. Exclusions are set on each Recipe and its Ingredients.
couldntHint.advance_step: Each Recipe needs preparing ahead and the time has gone. Choose a quicker Recipe for these Meal Slots.
couldntHint.too_early: Cooking any of your Recipes would have to start outside your cooking times (Earliest start and Latest start in Planning rules). Choose a quicker Recipe for these Meal Slots.
couldntHint.no_fit: The planner found nothing that suits these Meal Slots. Choose a Recipe yourself.

couldntShort.slot_rule: Its Slot Rule can't be met.
couldntShort.advance_step: Too late for an Advance Step.

couldntExclusions.title: Review Exclusions
couldntExclusions.summaryHint: Change an Exclusion below, or choose a Recipe by hand on the Plan.
couldntExclusions.ruleOut: __fn__(n, list) => n === 1 ? `Rules out 1 Recipe: ${list}` : `Rules out ${n} Recipes: ${list}`
couldntExclusions.optOutOne: __fn__(who, course) => `${who} opts out of ${course}, so ${who}'s Exclusions don't count here.`
couldntExclusions.optOutMany: __fn__(who, course) => `${who} opt out of ${course}, so their Exclusions don't count here.`
couldntExclusions.stillWorking: Feeder is still working out which Exclusions these are. Check again in a moment.
couldntExclusions.emptyTitle: No Course is held back by Exclusions now.
couldntExclusions.failed: The Exclusions could not be loaded.

couldntSlotRuleOne: Nothing that matches its Slot Rule is available.
couldntSlotRuleMany: Nothing that matches their Slot Rules is available.
relaxedCoolOne: Few Recipes, so this comes round sooner. Add Recipes for more variety.
relaxedCoolCourse: __fn__(course) => `Few ${course} Recipes, so this comes round sooner. Add ${course} Recipes for more variety.`
relaxedVariety: __fn__(tag) => `Few Recipes without ${tag} fit here, so this breaks a Variety Rule.`

slotDate.confirmBody: __fn__(dayName) => `${dayName} is left out of the plan, the Shopping List and reminders.`
slotDate.boughtStays: What you bought stays in Stock.
slotDate.datePast: That date has passed, so it cannot change.
slotDate.slotStarted: __fn__(slot) => `Part of ${slot} is already Cooked or Not cooked, so it cannot be left out.`
slotDate.failed: Could not save that. Try again.

markSlot.nothingLeft: Nothing is left to mark Cooked there.

causeChip.advance_step: Too late for its Advance Step

markSheet.lede: __fn__(course) => `The planner fills ${course} only from Recipes marked with it. Tick the ones you would serve as ${course}.`
markSheet.loadFailed: The Recipes could not be loaded.
markSheet.marked: __fn__(n, course) => n === 1 ? `1 Recipe marked as ${course}` : `${n} Recipes marked as ${course}`
markSheet.unmarked: __fn__(n, course) => n === 1 ? `1 Recipe is no longer marked as ${course}` : `${n} Recipes are no longer marked as ${course}`

startChip.outsideTitle: Cooking would start outside your cooking times

heroHint.one: __fn__(time, recipe, duration) => `Ready at ${time}. ${recipe} needs ${duration}, so start it now.`

swapNote: Later meals that aren't Pinned may move to make room. You can review and undo them.
chosenAndMarked: __fn__(recipe, slot, course) => `${recipe} chosen for ${slot} and marked as ${course}`

sheetFacts.outside: __fn__(time) => `Cooking would start at ${time}, outside your cooking times.`
sheetFacts.outsideOn: __fn__(day, time) => `Cooking would start on ${day} at ${time}, outside your cooking times.`
